title: Deterministic Command Log & Time-Travel Replay
description: Trace how pure commands append to an immutable log and replay deterministically to any cursor index.

steps.label: 1. Capture Pure Command
steps.description: Timestamp and UUID are computed at dispatch time so the command object is 100% deterministic.

steps.label: 2. Scrub Cursor Backward (Time Travel)
steps.description: User or debugger moves cursor to seq 1; runtime folds from nearest checkpoint @0 through seq 1.

steps.label: 3. Export Reproducible Bug Trace
steps.description: Serializing log[0..2] to JSON reproduces the exact state sequence on any developer machine.
